ISRO ICRB Scientist / Engineer New Exam Date 2026 – Full Details

Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) has released the exam date for the post of Scientist / Engineer. This recruitment was released for 175 posts. Online applying process for ISRO ICRB Scientist / Engineer Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 27 August 2026 to 16 September 2026. The CBT examination is going to conducted on 29 October 2026. Candidates who had applied this form can download their ISRO ICRB Scientist / Engineer Exam Date 2026 from the link given below

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 27 August 2026
  • Last Date : 16 September 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 16 September 2026
  • Exam Date : 29 October 2026
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General / OBC / EWS : Rs. 750/-
  • SC, ST, PH, ESM : Rs. 750/-
  • All Category : Rs. 750/-

How to Apply Online

  1. Click on the direct Apply Online link in the Important Links section below.
  2. Complete new registration with your Name, Email, and Mobile Number.
  3. Fill the application form with personal, educational, and address details.
  4. Upload scanned photograph, signature, and required certificates.
  5. Pay the applicable examination fee online and download the submission receipt.
